data.name: IndexTitle
data.comment: Title and heading of index.html, in the readable pages inside a backup ZIP. These pages are opened in a browser, outside the app.

data.name: IndexIntro
data.value: Made by Stikling on {0}. Open a plant or a cutting to read about it.
data.comment: {0} is the date the backup was made.

data.name: PartNote
data.value: This is part {0} of {1} of the backup. Plants and cuttings kept in another part are marked with that part.
data.comment: Only when a backup is split into several ZIP files. {0} is this part, {1} how many there are.

data.name: InPart
data.comment: Beside a plant or cutting that is in another ZIP file. {0} is the part number.

data.name: PlantsHeading
data.comment: Heading above the plants on the index.

data.name: CuttingsHeading
data.comment: Heading above the cuttings on the index, and on a plant's page above the cuttings taken from it.

data.name: NoRoom
data.comment: Group of plants that have no room.

data.name: LeftCollection
data.comment: Group of plants that died, were given away or sold.

data.name: NothingYet
data.comment: Shown when the collection is empty.

data.name: NumberOf
data.comment: The collection number. {0} is the number.

data.name: ReceivedOn
data.comment: On the index. {0} is a date.

data.name: StartedOn
data.comment: On the index, for a cutting. {0} is a date.

data.name: BackToIndex
data.comment: Link back to the index from a page.

data.name: From
data.comment: The parent plant of a cutting or plant.

data.name: ProbablyFrom
data.comment: Same, when the parent is a guess.

data.name: SmallPhotosNote
data.value: This backup has the photos in a small size only.
data.comment: Shown on every page when the backup was made without full size photos.

data.name: ReadMe
data.value: Open index.html in a browser to read your collection. data.json and the photos folder are the backup Stikling restores from.
data.comment: Text file in the ZIP, next to index.html. Plain text, no HTML.
